fields.step1_body:
35% of US workers have a side income.
Younger workers: nearly twice as likely.
They didn't start smarter. They started.
The free Skill Finder is where you start.
fields.step2_body:
You've watched the same problems for decades.
You know which fixes last and which don't.
Younger workers can't fake that.
But you have to pick one to sell.
fields.step3_body:
The one people at work brought to you.
The one you could fix half asleep.
Ask Claude who pays to have it fixed.
Then make it small enough to test.
fields.step4_body:
Keep the job. Test it on a weeknight.
One offer, one buyer, one conversation.
Claude drafts. You decide.
Late is fine. Never is the problem.
fields.cta_subtext: Comment {o:SKILLS} and I'll DM you my free Skill Finder: 12 questions, then AI names your 3 most sellable skills.
